counterfactual_missing_items: no mention of typical endocarditis symptoms
no mention of elevated inflammatory markers
decisive_items: a ~9 mm round, hyperechoic mass adherent to the ventricular surface of the anterior tricuspid leaflet
a 6×8 mm non-solid structure on the ventricular aspect of the anterior tricuspid leaflet with a “finger-in-glove” blind-ended protrusion
response.rationale: The description of the mass on the tricuspid leaflet matches the characteristic appearance of a papillary fibroelastoma, and the negative blood cultures make endocarditis less likely.

rejected.why: Lambert-Eaton Myasthenic Syndrome is not supported by the presence of a mass on the tricuspid leaflet
Atherosclerotic disease is not directly related to the mass on the tricuspid leaflet
